reader.requirement: At --std 85, the data-name-1 of a sequential file's RECORD IS VARYING ... DEPENDING ON phrase must describe an elementary unsigned integer in the Working-Storage or Linkage Section: a group, a signed, non-integer, alphanumeric or index item, and an item of the File or Communication Section, are refused; an unsigned integer of any usage there (and a level-66 renaming one) is accepted and carries the record length.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.DialectLevel >= Since; the three DEPENDING-operand rows have Since = 85, so they apply at 85 exactly as at 2023
message text only: below 2002 the sentence names working-storage or linkage, from 2002 it adds local-storage
the citation printed: Of1985 (§1985:VII.3.8.3 SR4) at 85, §2023:13.18.43.3 SR6 otherwise

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the section row admits LOCAL-STORAGE, which exists from 2002; at 85 the LOCAL-STORAGE SECTION itself is refused (COBOL0900), so the admitted set is Working-Storage and Linkage as the 1985 text says; the decision predicates are otherwise the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover bounds/DEPENDING at large and a level-66 data-name-1; signed, non-integer, alphanumeric, group, index, table-element, File Section and Communication Section operands and a Linkage operand are exercised only by the probes here

reader.notes: SR4 ships as three table rows (elementary, unsigned integer, section) in RecordClauseRules, each with a 1985 citation; the operand is resolved in FileControlBinder.ResolveFiles and a table element is refused there (COBOL2270). All refusals name the 1985 rule at --std 85, and the legal forms run with correct record lengths. A probe-side PIC mismatch (outer DISPLAY item passed to a COMP linkage item) printed garbage for the outer item and is not a compiler fault.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-236/runs: refused -- PIC PP9 (not an integer, COBOL2922 citing §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR4), PIC 9(3) BLANK WHEN ZERO (numeric edited by §1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2, COBOL2922), a level-88 condition-name (COBOL1639), an unqualified ambiguous L (COBOL1639 uniqueness); accepted -- level-77 PIC 9(3), qualified L OF G2, an item of an EXTERNAL Working-Storage record; r5_nested: a contained program's FD RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON a container's GLOBAL Working-Storage counter compiles, writes a 4-character record and READ sets L=004 (1985 SR4 asks only Working-Storage or Linkage, no same-Data-Division clause). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR4  (3.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4'. RecordClauseRules applies the rows at Since=85 with the 1985 sentence and citation; no missed edition site found. 'OK  §1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2' (the BLANK WHEN ZERO category rule; a first try at VI.5.3.4 failed and was corrected).
